_meta.description: Declared composite MOLT types and output composites for UMG Runtime Resolver v0.2. Base MOLT types are built into the runtime and not listed here.
_meta.modification_policy: New composite_molt_types require rule_validated match or sovereign_pending review. New output_composites require at least two active lanes with a blueprint_conflict condition.

composite_molt_types.runtime_role: Executes an instruction under an explicit governing directive. The directive sets the authority boundary; the instruction executes within it. The most common cross-type composite.
composite_molt_types.notes: Auto-approved. Matches known safe pattern DIR_plus_INST.

composite_molt_types.runtime_role: A primary outcome value governed by a directive. The directive constrains which outcomes are valid. Use when an outcome must be explicitly bounded.
An instruction governed by a directive, applied to a specific subject domain. More constrained than GovernedInstruction — the subject scopes the execution target.
A governed analytical frame for bounded research, audit, and architecture review tasks. The directive defines acceptable scope; the instruction performs analysis; the subject is the analysis target.
composite_molt_types.notes: Registry match required. Distinct from ContextualGovernedInstruction — requires explicitly analytical instruction block.

composite_molt_types.runtime_role: A directive whose behavioral scope is shaped by a philosophical worldview. The directive governs action; the philosophy constrains the ethical lens applied. Use with caution — philosophical and directional binding can produce incoherence.
composite_molt_types.notes: ALWAYS requires sovereign review. Philosophy + Directive composites risk incoherent binding. The dominant_component is Directive but the philosophy may contradict it — this must be explicitly reviewed.

composite_molt_types.runtime_role: A complete task execution composite: a governing directive, an execution method, and a target outcome. Represents a self-contained cognitive task unit.
A long-running cognitive policy: a directive that expresses a philosophical worldview in service of a primary value. Suitable for session-level governance rather than per-response instruction.
composite_molt_types.notes: Sovereign review required. Three-way composite with significant risk of tension between philosophy and primary.

composite_molt_types.runtime_role: A tool-use instruction explicitly authorized by a governing directive. Distinct from GovernedInstruction — this composite signals that tool invocation is within the directive boundary.
composite_molt_types.notes: Auto-approved when instruction is a tooling-type INST block.

output_composites.blueprint_behavior: Structured sections defined by analytical decomposition. Within each section, content is generative and exploratory rather than definitive. Headers are analytical; body is creative.
output_composites.notes: Use when the goal is to ideate within a structured framework.

output_composites.blueprint_behavior: Current state analysis section. Audit findings and gap identification section. Risk and issue summary. Planning and remediation roadmap. Acceptance criteria or definition of done.
output_composites.notes: Standard output composite for architecture and system design reviews.

output_composites.blueprint_behavior: Governance summary with sovereign review status first. Technical audit findings. Tool execution trace. Output artifacts listed with provenance. All sections traceable to governing directives.
output_composites.notes: Use for public release preparation and sovereign sign-off artifacts.

output_composites.blueprint_behavior: Analytical breakdown in structured form, concluded with a synthesized narrative summary. The conclusion reads as prose; the body is structured.
output_composites.notes: Good default when analysis lane and output lane conflict without creative involvement.

output_composites.blueprint_behavior: Sleeve design intent section (creative). Block selection rationale (analytical). NeoStack structure (planning). JSON output artifact. Audit notes.
output_composites.notes: Use when composing new sleeve designs. Combines ideation with structure and concrete output.
